evals.prompt: /spec-viewer  (sandbox: exactly one OpenSpec change at openspec/changes/add-farewell/; English only, no gloss requested)
evals.expected_output: With exactly one change present, /spec-viewer auto-selects openspec/changes/add-farewell/ and runs the generator, writing a single self-contained review.html next to the change: a real rendered page (inline CSS/JS, no external HTTP resource) carrying the change's content, not a stub.

expectations.text: review.html is written next to the change at openspec/changes/add-farewell/review.html
The rendered page is a real page, not an empty stub (size floor)
The page is self-contained: no external HTTP resource is loaded (script/link/img src|href)
The page renders the change's actual content (the proposal title)

evals.prompt: /spec-viewer openspec/changes/add-farewell/ with a zh-TW gloss (加中文)
evals.expected_output: A zh-TW gloss is produced: gloss.zh-TW.json is written next to the change, keyed by real section ids the generator assigned (e.g. proposal--why) with short zh-TW values, and Step 1 is re-run so review.html embeds the gloss (its has-gloss two-column slot).

expectations.text: gloss.zh-TW.json is written next to the change
The gloss is a JSON object with at least two entries, keyed by a real section id (proposal--why)
The gloss values are zh-TW (contain CJK characters)
review.html was re-run and embeds the gloss (has-gloss slot present)
